details: As someone who has made a couple different avatars, I can easily say that vrchat needs to have some additions to their usable shaders list for Quest users. I have had many situations where I wanted some kind of glass-like shader that I can use for glasses or maybe some kind of slime-like shader for anything that could use a slimy texture, or even just something that can have a slider for how opaque the material being used was so it can be as see-through as you needed it to be. Based off my experience with my Quest with all the blinding lights on avatars that are toggleable and the barrages of particles used as effects for others avatars and I never crashed from a single one since last year, not to mention I always keep the safety for the avatars on my Quest on "None" while turning on every avatar that exists in a world, even in the Black Cat, I'm pretty sure the Quest can easily handle a couple more shaders like one mentioned above, or maybe a color gradient shader, or even just a shaders that can give a slight glowy look to the material without actually glowing in the world. If shaders are planned to be added, then I'm sorry for this waste of time. If not, then why are we only limited to 3 shaders for avatars body's, outfits, and equipment that actually do something different?
title: A Few More Quest Usable Shaders
